answer: Every epoch a tide sweep scans the endorsement graph for dense clusters of identities that vouch only for each other and freezes them. Each frozen identity must pass a fresh live skill check set by an unrelated auditor to thaw, and one opal token is issued per thawed key, never twice for the same key. A Sybil farm must either stay sparse and small, or pay for many live checks while its sponsors' bonds are slashed, because a single failed check freezes the whole juniper branch of its endorsements.
